LESSON: USE OF NATURAL RESOURCES

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation 2.3 Responsibility over Plants (6 lessons) By the end of the sub- stran
Topic 2.4: Use of Natural Resources

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Use of Natural Resources
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why should you conserve the environment?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain ways in which human beings use and misuse natural resources
2. discuss Biblical teachings on good use of natural resources
3. conserve the environment as responsible citizens

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: explain ways in which human beings use and misuse natural resources

Teach
• Today’s focus: explain ways in which human beings use and misuse natural resources.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “explain ways in which human beings use and misuse natural resources” using a home/county example.

Try this

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: discuss Biblical teachings on good use of natural resources

Teach

• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Try this

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 3: conserve the environment as responsible citizens

Teach
• Today’s focus: conserve the environment as responsible citizens.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

• Model B for “conserve the environment as responsible citizens” using a home/county example.

Try this

• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: explain ways in which human beings use and misuse natural resources
• Model 2: discuss Biblical teachings on good use of natural resources
• Model 3: conserve the environment as responsible citizens

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: explain ways in which human beings use and misuse natural resources
2. Practise: discuss Biblical teachings on good use of natural resources
3. Practise: conserve the environment as responsible citizens

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Use of Natural Resources.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should you conserve the environment?
2. How do human beings benefit from natural resources?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• explain ways in which human beings use and misuse natural resources
• discuss Biblical teachings on good use of natural resources
• conserve the environment as responsible citizens
